name: Date forecast
summary: A weather dial for a friend's first date: everyone except her taps the dial from stormy to sunny (second date) and their face lands on the arc; afterwards she sets the real weather with one tap, the needle swings over and the faces near it called it. Kind by design; she can hide it any time.
useWhen: maya has a first date at kettle & crumb at 4
predictions for her date tonight, nice ones only
how do we think his date goes
forecast for the first date, report back at 6
rate the vibes before the date
dontUseWhen: rating someone's looks or a profile (use hinge-rate)
the person on the date hasn't shared it with the chat
betting with points or money (use over-under)

who.description: Whose date it is (a name in the chat); she can't forecast and is the one who calls it

plan.description: Where and when, as the chat said it, e.g. 'Kettle & Crumb at 4'

forecasts.description: Forecasts already in, with what each person said in their own words; kind only
